tables.name: Workspace_Location
tables.comment: Partial unique: at most one is_default=true location per workspace — uniqueIndex workspace_location_one_default_per_workspace WHERE is_default. DrawDB cannot express the partial WHERE.

tables.name: Workspace_Invite
tables.comment: Partial unique: only one pending invite per (workspaceId, email) — uniqueIndex workspace_invite_workspace_email_pending_unique WHERE status = 'pending'. DrawDB cannot express the partial WHERE, so it is represented as a plain index here.
